## Body

# Security verdict, PR #299, round 2 (final, C34), head 1906566b

Result: PASS. S299-N1 and S299-N2 are closed, and no new finding.

## R299-001 / Linux (security view)
`Holders::read()` -> `read_on(std::env::consts::OS)`, a compile-time constant that no environment variable can steer. "linux" returns `Unknown(LINUX_UNKNOWN)`, and the Linux `bound_paths()` returns Err too, a second stop on the same path. The /proc census, `foreign()`, the fake-/proc seam and the /proc/net/unix parser are deleted, which closes round 1's Q1 residuals (a) to (d) and the hidepid availability note. The `Holders::of`/`of_bound` constructors stay public, but their only callers outside the module are the binary (which uses `read()`) and a `#[cfg(test)]` module in crates/tmux/src/control.rs:1026. No production path on Linux builds `Known`. The macOS residual (lsof's walk is not atomic, plus SCM_RIGHTS in flight) is named in the module doc.

## S299-N1: closed
The stat-failure reason renders `{path:?}` (Debug: `\n`, `\u{1b}`, `\xFF`), the lsof decode failure renders `escape_ascii()`, and the sample `e.g.` names render `escape_debug()`. The raw `from_utf8_lossy` line renderer went with the /proc parser. Test `a_bound_path_in_a_reason_is_escaped` covers newline, ESC and 0xff. The remaining `display()` sinks are the hardcoded lsof path, the operator's own `--dir`, and test assertions. Residual, not new and not counted: bounce-rs's own `lsof named $name` refusal (since #298) still prints the decoded name raw. It comes from the same user (C33) and is out of this delta.

## S299-N2: closed
`case "$UID" in '' | *[!0-9]*) status=uid` runs before any lsof launch. I probed it under the host's /bin/bash 3.2 with these values: `^501`, empty, `501,0`, a leading or trailing space, `-u`, `$(touch …)` (nothing was executed), and Arabic-Indic digits. All refuse, and only a value that is all ASCII digits launches. The refusal message doesn't echo the UID value, so it can't inject. `PIJ_BOUNCE_UNSAFE=1` still goes on, as before, with its printed audit line. A numeric spoof such as `UID=0` still fails closed (lsof exits 1 for another uid as non-root, receipt from round 1).

## Public-repo / C21
The delta and the cumulative diff contain no home paths or secret patterns. The D-SEC-1, D-F248-1 and D-F247-1 ledger rows are clean, as are the commit message and PR body. No lockfile or .npmrc change, and `refs/notes/*` is empty on origin.

## Cost (security view)
The Linux /proc walk is gone, and no launches are added. The non-number UID branch launches nothing. Performance owns the measurements.
